detail.longDescription: Valve has open-sourced Lepton, its compatibility layer for running Android games on Linux. Much like Proton brought Windows games to Linux, Lepton is focused on Android games, especially VR titles being brought to Steam Frame. It uses a lightweight Android container while tying directly into Linux graphics and Steam. Another useful Valve project opened to the community. https:// gitlab.steamos.cloud/frame-pub lic/lepton # Linux # OpenSource # Valve # SteamOS
